# The RT64 shaders the web page builds before the game starts: one shader description a line, other mode L and H,
# color combiner L and H, flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and compiles them
# all while the page shows "Preparing graphics", so nothing draws with the ubershader in the middle of play, which
# integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README, "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders").
#
# Recorded from the page opened with ?record-shaders, which prints every description RT64 meets, at the page's
# default settings (2026-10-12): the attract demo, the title screen, file select and naming a file, the intro in the
# Lost Woods, the fall and Skull Kid's curse, Deku Link in the Clock Tower (the Happy Mask Salesman) and every part of
# Clock Town with several of its houses, the pause menu's item, map, quest and mask screens, text boxes, and, warped to
# through the game's debug warp table (scene_table.cpp) as Deku Link: Termina Field (day 1, night, the rain of day 2,
# day 3), the Observatory, the swamp, Deku Palace, Woodfall and its temple and Odolwa, the mountain, Goron Village and
# Shrine, Snowhead and its temple and Goht, the Goron racetrack, Great Bay's coast, Zora Cape and Hall, the Pirates'
# Fortress inside and out, Great Bay Temple and Gyorg, the lab, the road to Ikana, its graveyard and canyon, Stone
# Tower and both temples, the castle, the well, Twinmold, Romani Ranch, Milk Road, the Moon and Majora's arena, a fairy
# fountain, a grotto and the Chamber of Giants. Night and the other days added one shader. Not yet: human, Goron, Zora
# and Fierce Deity Link outside the intro, items in use (bow, hookshot, bombs, Deku bubbles), most boss fights past
# their intro, the minigames, the Pictograph Box, the final cutscenes and credits. A description missing here draws
# with the ubershader until its shader is built. Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so
# a change to one of those defaults means recording again.
